All axial contact weights are explicitly nonnegative, strict cap behavior and affine shear are verified, and the two formulas meet at lambda=(n-1)/(n+1). Exact rational replay of check_frusta.py passes 197 dimension/parameter cases. Boundary endpoints, full-dimensionality and the distinction between a finite check and a universal proof are accounted for.

originality.rationale: A published exact single-half-cone result is acknowledged. The new statement gives an exact whole-parameter profile and lifts optimality from a circular cone to every asymmetric or nonsmooth base through a finite base-contact frame; a single round half-cone result does not imply that transfer. The 2007 primary source explicitly treats outer conical frusta but not their inner John ellipsoids, while the September 2026 motivating primary source gives only one feasible round-cut witness. Targeted named-parameter, equivalent-claim, published-finding corpus and published-literature searches found no matching general profile. Unindexed priority and unread full mathematical records remain limitations, not a claim of exhaustive novelty.

value.rationale: For every convex base, the previously high-dimensional optimization for its homothetic frustum reduces to knowing one base John ellipsoid and one scalar. This gives a complete class theorem encompassing asymmetric pyramids and frusta, a genuine active-cap transition at lambda=(n-1)/(n+1), an exact volume law, and a non-C2 transition. This structural independence is motivated by the special 2026 cone sharpness model and cannot be obtained as a numerical table or trivial substitution of that one model.
